step12_blocking_findings.blocking_effect: Model completely ignores difficulty, marks, and format control tags.

Model defaults to MCQ stems when Numerical or Conceptual formats are requested.
80.59% of numerical calculation prompts fail mathematical verification.
Exact training substring match rate exceeds safety ceiling.
Generic MCQ stems omit specific subject and topic terminology.

blocking_reasons: V16 failed 7 out of 9 mandatory Phase 18 quality gates in Step 11 evaluation.
Total Control Blindness (0.00% sensitivity) makes model unusable for API parameter controls (difficulty/type/marks).
Severe Template Collapse (100.0% top-10 concentration) produces repetitive generic MCQ stems.
Numerical Validity (19.41%) fails production mathematical calculation accuracy benchmark (85.0%).
Physical final V16 model weights were not recovered locally in the workspace.
future_remediation_requirements: Rebalance dataset supervision targets to penalize dominant MCQ template stems.
Introduce explicit control-token loss functions during training to enforce parameter sensitivity.
Scale model architecture from FLAN-T5-small (80M) to FLAN-T5-base (250M) for mathematical reasoning.
Implement multi-step step-by-step chain-of-thought fine-tuning data for numerical calculation prompts.
